sections.advice: back through The Appia Traiana along the Adriatic coast → Brundisium is 33 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Brundisium → The Appia Traiana along the Adriatic coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

story: From Brindisi it runs 324 km to Brindisi; allow about 5 h 35 of riding. The stops in between: The Appia Traiana along the Adriatic coast, The Via Appia from Mesochorum to Scamnum, Tarentum and Quartiere Monti. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
